dict.string: Peripheral Glow Track 6: Bright vocal-like sine tone. Forward in mix. Use with Scanner Vibrato (5Hz, 15% depth, 35% mix), ChromaVerb (2.0s, 35% wet), Stereo Delay (dotted 1/8, 20% feedback, 15% wet).
Range: D4-D6. The "voice" of the song. Verse vel 55-58, Chorus 62-68, Verse 3 (sparse) 30-40. Grace notes on some phrases. C#5->D5 chromatic homecoming in Verse 3 bar 8.
